title: There's Plenty of Positive Action But It's a Little Overheated
text:
There's Plenty of Positive Action But It's a Little Overheated By casa 
We have some mild selling into the follow-through action this morning but big cap names like Micron ( MU ) , Tesla ( TSLA ) and Alphabet ( GOOGL ) are keeping the momentum running. The big Kahuna, Apple ( AAPL ) is breaking to a new high. That name along with Amazon ( AMZN ) and that doing a lot of heavy lifting. 
Under the surface there is some profit taking occurring but it is relatively mild. Breadth is running around 4100 gainers to 2400 decliners and new 12-month highs are up to over 400. 
I've been a net seller into this strength but there are quite a few good looking stocks on my screens. Biotechnology is a little weak but names like Sarepta ( SRPT ) , Sorrento ( SRNE ) and Cara ( CARA ) are acting well. 
My Stock of the Week, PagSeguro Digital ( PAGS ) is dipping after a very strong start but prior Stock of the Week, Casa Systems ( CASA ) is ripping higher again. 
As always I'm looking for some new buys so the early reversals are not unwelcome. There is plenty of positive action but the action is a little overheated and we could use some cooling off.
